name: Abhisek Mitra
shortBio: Leads day-to-day operations and social media strategy, keeping every client's brand consistent, on time and growing.
bio:
Abhisek brings more than 12 years of experience in operations and social media to Connekt India. He leads the team day to day, plans content strategy for every client and makes sure each campaign goes out on time and on brand.

Clients work with Abhisek as their main point of contact. He turns business goals into clear monthly plans, keeps the creative, tech and ads teams in sync, and reviews results every month so each brand keeps moving forward.

name: Dibyaranjan Das
shortBio: Builds the websites, software and AI-powered automations that help our clients work smarter and grow faster.
bio:
Dibyaranjan heads technology at Connekt India. He builds fast, secure websites, custom software and AI-powered tools that save our clients time and turn their data into decisions.

From e-commerce stores and CRMs to chatbots and workflow automation, he looks for the simplest technology that solves the real business problem, and makes sure it scales as the brand grows.

name: Sudhansu Sekhar Sahoo
role: SEO, Meta Ads & Social Media Expert
shortBio: Drives visibility and leads through SEO, Meta Ads and data-backed social media growth.
bio:
Sudhansu makes sure our clients get found and get enquiries. He manages search engine optimisation, local SEO and Google Business Profiles, and plans and runs Meta Ads campaigns built around leads and sales.

He tracks every campaign closely, tests creatives and audiences, and shares clear reports so clients always know what their budget is delivering.

name: Chitaranjan Sahoo
shortBio: Crafts scroll-stopping designs, brand visuals and edited videos that make our clients look premium.
bio:
Chitaranjan is the creative eye behind many of our brand identities, social posts and campaign visuals. He designs logos, brand systems, packaging and print material, and edits videos that keep audiences watching.

He works closely with the social and ads teams so that every creative is not only beautiful but also built to perform.

name: Himanshu Sekhar Dash
shortBio: Shoots the reels, brand films and product videos that bring our clients' stories to life.
bio:
Himanshu handles on-ground production at Connekt India. He plans and shoots reels, brand films, product videos and event coverage, with a keen eye for lighting, framing and movement.

Whether it is a gym, a jewellery showroom or a café, he captures footage that feels authentic and premium, ready for the edit.

name: Chinmaya Ranjan Pradhan
shortBio: Turns raw footage into fast-paced reels and polished videos built for Instagram and YouTube.
bio:
Chinmaya edits the reels and videos that our clients publish every week. He shapes raw footage into tight, engaging stories with smooth transitions, colour grading, captions and sound design.

He keeps up with trends on Instagram and YouTube so every edit feels fresh and is optimised for the platform it lives on.
